title: Flöten und Dolche: Novellen
summary: "Flöten und Dolche: Novellen" by Heinrich Mann is a collection of four novellas published in 1905. The title itself signals a tension between art and life—flutes and daggers. These tales span across Italian settings, exploring themes of passion, idealism, and disillusionment. From a woman's memories of fighting for Italian unification to a young knight's failed quest for glory and love, Mann presents characters caught between romantic aspirations and harsh reality.
